subject.title: Suppress duplicate session lock timeout replies

question: Should a lock timeout from a contending turn intentionally produce no user-visible reply when a different, actively registered reply run owns the same session lock?
rationale: The code can conservatively distinguish active, ended, same-run, and uncorrelated owners, but only product owners can decide whether the active owner reliably represents the outcome the user should receive instead of an explicit failure from the contender.

options.title: Accept correlated silence
options.body: Merge the narrow suppression rule, relying on the distinct active owner to finish the user-visible session outcome while preserving visible errors for every other contention class.

options.title: Keep every timeout visible
options.body: Reject silent contention handling and retain the existing generic failure reply until a broader user-facing coordination model is designed.

recommendation.title: Accept correlated silence
recommendation.body: Merge the narrow suppression rule, relying on the distinct active owner to finish the user-visible session outcome while preserving visible errors for every other contention class.
